rules: Chat/topic list scroll MUST update selectedIndex within maxSwipeSelectionMs without triggering a full bridge.render.
Chat/topic list scroll MUST dispatch a sidebar panel partial render through bridge.enqueueSidebarPanel, NOT a full bridge.render or awaited bridge.renderSidebarPanel.
The hidden native list (container 8) MUST remain non-capturing; partial renders update the app-rendered sidebar marker and panel without relying on firmware-owned selection.
Rapid list swipes MUST coalesce: only the most recent panel model ever reaches the glasses. getPartialRenderStats().dropped > 0 is expected during a swipe streak.
Background refreshes (polling, SSE updates) MUST NOT overwrite controller-owned sidebar selection or force an unnecessary full rebuild.
Async results from stale requests (previous chat open that was abandoned) MUST be discarded silently.

right.panelBodyNotes: panelBody is the plain-text fallback (startup page, refused native list); the glasses show nativeList.items

transitions.click(row): sidebar.messages / sidebar.topics / sidebar.chats (Back to top, More chats...)

sidebar.chats.notes: Drawn as a native (firmware) list: the glasses move a selection box with momentum and report only the row clicked. Swipes reach the app as nothing (simulator) or bare scroll events, never redraw the list, and do not change selectedChatIndex, which is the list's anchor: the window starts there (0 = top; after returning from a chat it is that chat, on row 0 where the firmware puts the selection box after a rebuild). At most 20 rows: 'More chats...' after the chats when chats follow (it fetches the next 20 from the server when needed), then 'Back to top' last when the window does not start at the top. Background changes do not redraw a list the user has swiped (footer 'New activity | ...'); they are drawn at the next rebuild the user causes (UI_INVARIANTS.md section 1.6). With Telegram folders, the title is '<folder> <n>/<total>' and double press opens sidebar.folderPicker instead of sleeping. If the host refuses a native list page the app falls back to the text list (panelBody with a '> ' marker the controller moves).

sidebar.topics.noPreview.notes: Text-list fallback only (the host refused native lists); the native topic list is sidebar.topics.

sidebar.topics.preview.notes: Text-list fallback only (the host refused native lists); the native topic list is sidebar.topics.

sidebar.folderPicker.notes: Options are ['All chats', ...folder titles, 'Sleep']. Not exercised by the fixture harness: the fixture account has no folders, so double press on the chat list sleeps directly there. Covered by web/test/controller.test.ts (folders).

transitions.click(row): sidebar.messages.topic / sidebar.topics (Back to top, More topics...)

sidebar.topics.notes: Native list of the forum's topics, full width, same windowing and click rules as sidebar.chats. The text fallback is sidebar.topics.noPreview / sidebar.topics.preview (left list + preview), used only when the host refuses native lists.

steps.name: 29a-typing-after-send
steps.comment: After sending a recorded message, the state is sidebar.messages with status='Sent'. If the other person starts typing, the typing indicator should replace the status in the footer. This test proves whether the typing update is accepted after the send completes. If the indicator does not appear, typing updates were dropped during the sidebarSending/sidebarSent transitions.
